title: Allegation
description: An asserted but unverified factual claim within a Proceeding. gist binding (v0.2): the assertion text maps to gist:Content; the asserter's speech-act intent maps to gist:Intention only when the claim itself is intent-bearing (e.g. libel, fraud). gist does not define a gist:Statement class. The alleged-vs-determined distinction is core: an Allegation is what was asserted, not what is true. A Determination resolves it.

text.description: The asserted facts in plain language.

asserted_by.description: Open vocabulary in v0.1 (claimant, plaintiff, complainant, prosecutor, agency, etc.). Closed vocabulary deferred to v0.2.

related_to.description: Optional IRI of the AI system, party, or other entity the Allegation concerns.

ref.description: Jurisdiction code: lowercase form of an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country/supranational code or an ISO 3166-2 subdivision code.

sameAs.description: owl:sameAs crosswalk IRIs: external records identical to this one (e.g. a live adopter export, a Wikidata entity).

exactMatch.description: skos:exactMatch crosswalk IRIs: external concepts interchangeably usable with this record (e.g. a named legal doctrine). Weaker than owl:sameAs; preferred for cross-scheme concept joins.

notes.description: Free-text editorial or provenance notes about this record.
